title: Delivery and Installation of Integrated Base Defense Security Systems (IBDSS) for buildings on Robins AFB
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND > AIR FORCE SUSTAINMENT CENTER > FA8501  OPL CONTRACTING AFSC/PZIO
description:
This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with the Revolutionary Federal Regulation Acquisition (FAR) Overhaul (RFO) part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. 

 Solicitation number FA8501-27-R-0003 is issued as a Request for Proposals (RFP) for the Delivery and Installation of Integrated Base Defense Security Systems (IBDSS) for buildings on Robins AFB. The only approved system is Honeywell Vindicator. 

 Responses dates shall be submitted by 18 December 2026 at 12:00p.m. EST. No late response will be accepted. 

 Work shall be completed on Robins AFB.  

 This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns and is associated with NAICS code 561621. The PSC associated with this effort is N063. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at https://www.acquisition.gov/far-overhaul/far-part-deviation-guide. 

 This requirement is to obtain a five (5) year, Firm Fixed Price, Requirements contract for the delivery and installation of IBDSS for buildings on Robins AFB. The period of performance shall consist of a basic one-year (1) period and four (4) one (1) year subsequent option years after contract award for a total of five (5) years. 

  

 Each order against this requirements contract will be negotiated at order level. The solicitation includes attachment titled “Building List” which lists all possible orders throughout the life of the resultant contract. The solicitation includes attachment titled “Example Project” as an example order, which offerors should propose to in accordance with RFO 52.212-1 and 52.212-2 of the subject solicitation. Offerors should affirm the price of the Example Project from date of offer through 31 March 2027. 

  

 This effort will be completed utilizing Price Only with a Special Standard of Responsibility (SSR). The SSR for this effort must meet one of the following criteria: (1) a current and valid Honeywell Vindicator certified Installer/Technician certification, or (2) an official, signed verification letter on Honeywell letterhead confirming that the offeror’s personnel assigned to perform the installation are currently certified Honeywell Vindicator technicians. 

 Site visits are mandatory and will be held at 220 Third Street, Bldg. 231, Robins AFB 31098-1808 on 8 December 2026 beginning at 9:00 a.m. EST. 

 TSgt Joshua Welch (joshua.welch.4@us.af.mil), William Atkinson (478-926-5987, william.atkinson.5@us.af.mil) and Erickson Watkins (478-222-3891, erickson.watkins@us.af.mil) will meet all contractors at the Visitors Center at 9:00 a.m. EST on 8 December 2026. Contractors are required to provide identification including driver’s license, and one (1) other form of identification (birth certificate, social security card, passport), and current vehicle registration. Visitor’s Center address is 218 Oak Ave, Warner Robins, GA 31088. The site visit location does not allow for any photography, please bring any necessary equipment to measure and take notes. 

 No remarks, explanations, or answers provided during the site visit will qualify or amend any written terms and conditions of the RFP. All questions which may arise from the site visit shall be submitted via email to Jessica Cobb (Jessica.cobb.3@us.af.mil) and Kevin Hinman (kevin.hinman.2@us.af.mil) by 4:00 p.m. EST on 15 December 2026. 

 The Government reserves the right to make no award. The Government reserves the right to cancel this solicitation either before or after the closing date. In the event the Government cancels this solicitation, the Government shall not reimburse an offeror for any costs associated with this solicitation.
